sources.title: LibreYOLO/LibreRTDETRv2s-obb · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LibreRTDETRv2s-obb RT-DETRv2-S oriented-object detector trained on DOTA 1.0 and converted for LibreYOLO. Source The architecture is derived from RicePasteM/RiO-DETR at commit 22d5232a4e0df6ac4bc26ed1c8aac8b4060449c7. The official checkpoint comes from RicePasteM/RT-DETR-OBB at revision f376e9dcedfb9a47a21ac71ef61ad99f8b545698.

sources.snippet: Training new models, such as LibreYOLO26 and MIT retrains of families with restrictive weights, costs rented GPU time, and the LibreYOLO Sponsorship Program pays for it. Companies get their logo here from $100 a month, and from $500 a month are named in every release and in the model card of every weight released while they sponsor.
